title: WinoTS: Wavelet-based Self-Distillation for Time Series Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39337v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised pre-training of time series models is currently dominated by next-token prediction and reconstruction objectives. In continuous-valued domains, these paradigms often waste model capacity on high-frequency, point-wise noise at the expense of learning invariant structure. While invariance-based self-distillation has proven highly effective in computer vision, its application to temporal data remains largely underexplored. Effectively adapting such methods to time series requires carefully designed augmentations: spatial operations like cropping can shift the timing of repeating cycles or distort the signal, while basic jittering may provide limited variation. We introduce Wavelet-based self-distillation for time series (WinoTS), an invariance-based pre-training paradigm designed specifically for temporal signals. translated_title: WinoTS：基于小波自蒸馏的时间序列模型
translated_abstract: 时间序列模型的自监督预训练目前主要被下一个词预测和重建目标所主导。在连续值领域，这些范式常常将模型容量浪费在高频的逐点噪声上，从而牺牲了对不变结构的学习。尽管基于不变性的自蒸馏在计算机视觉领域已被证明极为有效，但其在时序数据上的应用在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。要有效地将此类方法适配到时间序列，需要精心设计的增强策略：诸如裁剪等空间操作可能会改变重复周期的时间或使信号失真，而基础的抖动扰动所能提供的变化有限。我们提出了 WinoTS（面向时间序列的基于小波的自蒸馏），这是一种专为时间信号设计的基于不变性的预训练范式。其核心在于，WinoTS 利用时频增强来构建多尺度结构视图，而无需 d……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: WinoTS 提出了一种基于小波时频增强的不变性自蒸馏预训练范式，专为时间序列设计，通过构建多尺度结构视图来避免模型容量被浪费在学习高频逐点噪声上。
